programme.title: North American Whitetail
programme.sub-title: NAW Kentucky Early Season Whitetail Hunt
programme.desc: On this episode of North American Whitetail we've got two action-packed deer hunts. Black Garlock and Clint McCoy hit our Kentucky lease in hopes of finding a mature buck. On Build Your On Deer Factory, Haynes Shelton and Dr. James Kroll show us some tricks when moving permanent blinds with a tractor. Next, in From The Stand, Blake Garlock shows us how to use trail cameras to locate a buck's core area. And we return to the Iowa Deer Classic with Haynes Shelton to take a look at the 1997 Sam Collera buck.

programme.title: North American Whitetail
programme.sub-title: Texas Giants with Dr. Deer and Haynes Shelton
programme.desc: This week on North American Whitetail, host Haynes Shelton joins Dr. Kroll in Texas in search of a giant Lone Star whitetail. On our On Target Segment, Dr. Kroll teaches us some techniques on rattling and then will show how to look for whitetail travel corridors on Dr. Deer. Finally, Haynes returns to the Iowa Deer Classic for a Big Buck Profile of Glen Saloe's whitetail buck.
